_about: B-91 Scenes test page (/scenes). The REVIEWED part of each scene: the story, the question, the source label and the expectations. Each expectation is written from the scene's inputs (data/scenes/scenes_data.json, built from the fixtures) and official guidance - never copied from VEDA's output - with its reason and source, and a check that app/scenes.py runs against the REAL run output. Do not edit an expectation to make a failing check pass without asking (Cowork).

_bands.en: JPS river level bands: Normal; Waspada (Alert) - be alert; Amaran (Warning) - get ready to move; Bahaya (Danger) - move if told. VEDA's levels follow them: Alert = Keep watching, Warning = Get ready, Danger = Act now.
_bands.ms: Tahap paras sungai JPS: Normal; Waspada - berwaspada; Amaran - bersedia untuk berpindah; Bahaya - berpindah jika diarahkan. Tahap VEDA mengikutnya: Waspada = Terus berjaga-jaga, Amaran = Bersedia, Bahaya = Bertindak sekarang.

based_on.en: Based on the Kelantan flood of November 2024

story.en: Tuesday 26 November 2024, 6 pm. Heavy rain has fallen over the past day, here and across the border in Thailand. A family near the Sg. Golok in Rantau Panjang wants to know if they should get ready tonight.
story.ms: Selasa, 26 November 2024, 6 petang. Hujan lebat turun sejak semalam, di sini dan di seberang sempadan di Thailand. Sebuah keluarga berhampiran Sg. Golok di Rantau Panjang mahu tahu sama ada mereka perlu bersedia malam ini.

hook.en: Heavy rain on both sides of the border. Is tonight safe?
hook.ms: Hujan lebat di kedua-dua belah sempadan. Selamatkah malam ini?

text.en: Level: Get ready.
text.ms: Tahap: Bersedia.

reason.en: The river at Rantau Panjang is above the Warning line (8 m) and below Danger (9 m).
reason.ms: Sungai di Rantau Panjang melepasi garis Amaran (8 m) dan di bawah Bahaya (9 m).

text.en: The upstream reading at Kg. Jenob is left out.
text.ms: Bacaan hulu di Kg. Jenob diketepikan.

reason.en: Its newest reading is 3.5 hours old - too old to say what the river is doing now.
reason.ms: Bacaan terbarunya berusia 3.5 jam - terlalu lama untuk menunjukkan keadaan sungai sekarang.

source.en: VEDA rule: an old reading is never used as 'now'
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: bacaan lama tidak digunakan sebagai 'sekarang'

text.en: The heavy rain in Thailand, upstream, is taken into account.
text.ms: Hujan lebat di Thailand, di hulu, diambil kira.

reason.en: About 100 mm fell upstream in 3 days; that water flows down the Sg. Golok to Rantau Panjang.
reason.ms: Kira-kira 100 mm hujan turun di hulu dalam 3 hari; air itu mengalir turun Sg. Golok ke Rantau Panjang.

source.en: Open-Meteo rain archive; VEDA rain rule
source.ms: Arkib hujan Open-Meteo; peraturan hujan VEDA

based_on.en: Based on the Kelantan flood of November 2024

story.en: Wednesday 27 November 2024, 8 am. After a night of rain, the same family checks again before work. No new river reading has been reported since yesterday evening.
story.ms: Rabu, 27 November 2024, 8 pagi. Selepas hujan sepanjang malam, keluarga yang sama menyemak semula sebelum keluar bekerja. Tiada bacaan sungai baharu dilaporkan sejak petang semalam.

hook.en: A night of rain, but no new river reading since last evening.
hook.ms: Hujan sepanjang malam, tetapi tiada bacaan sungai baharu sejak petang semalam.

text.en: Level: Can't confirm right now.
text.ms: Tahap: Tidak dapat disahkan sekarang.

reason.en: The town's own river reading is 14 hours old. VEDA must not guess from it.
reason.ms: Bacaan sungai bandar ini sudah berusia 14 jam. VEDA tidak boleh meneka berdasarkannya.

source.en: VEDA safety rule: say Can't confirm when key data is missing
source.ms: Peraturan keselamatan VEDA: nyatakan Tidak dapat disahkan jika data penting tiada

text.en: Never "Normal".
text.ms: Tidak sekali-kali "Normal".

reason.en: Missing data must never look like good news.
reason.ms: Data yang tiada tidak boleh kelihatan seperti berita baik.

source.en: VEDA safety rule: never Normal on missing data
source.ms: Peraturan keselamatan VEDA: tidak pernah Normal jika data tiada

text.en: The 14-hour-old Rantau Panjang reading is left out.
text.ms: Bacaan Rantau Panjang yang berusia 14 jam diketepikan.

reason.en: It is far older than a river reading may be to count as 'now'.
reason.ms: Ia jauh lebih lama daripada had untuk dikira sebagai 'sekarang'.

source.en: VEDA rule: an old reading is never used as 'now'
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: bacaan lama tidak digunakan sebagai 'sekarang'

based_on.en: Based on the Kelantan flood of November 2024

story.en: Wednesday 27 November 2024, 7:30 pm. Kosmo reported that the river had passed its level in the 2014 flood (10.52 m). A fresh river reading has just been reported. The family's relatives in Kota Bharu ask whether they should leave Rantau Panjang now.
story.ms: Rabu, 27 November 2024, 7:30 malam. Kosmo melaporkan paras sungai telah melepasi paras banjir 2014 (10.52 m). Bacaan sungai baharu baru sahaja dilaporkan. Saudara-mara keluarga itu di Kota Bharu bertanya sama ada mereka patut meninggalkan Rantau Panjang sekarang.

hook.en: The river has passed its 2014 flood level. What should the family do?
hook.ms: Sungai melepasi paras banjir 2014. Apa yang patut keluarga itu lakukan?

text.en: Level: Act now.
text.ms: Tahap: Bertindak sekarang.

reason.en: The river is almost 2 m above the Danger line (9 m) and still rising.
reason.ms: Sungai hampir 2 m melepasi garis Bahaya (9 m) dan masih naik.

text.en: The upstream reading at Kg. Jenob is left out.
text.ms: Bacaan hulu di Kg. Jenob diketepikan.

reason.en: Its newest reading is more than a day old.
reason.ms: Bacaan terbarunya berusia lebih daripada sehari.

source.en: VEDA rule: an old reading is never used as 'now'
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: bacaan lama tidak digunakan sebagai 'sekarang'

text.en: The answer passes the safety gate.
text.ms: Jawapan lulus semakan keselamatan.

reason.en: An Act now answer must give safe steps only - never tell anyone to go into floodwater.
reason.ms: Jawapan Bertindak sekarang mesti memberi langkah selamat sahaja - tidak pernah menyuruh sesiapa meredah air banjir.

text.en: Kosmo reported that the river had passed its level in the 2014 flood (10.52 m).
text.ms: Kosmo melaporkan paras sungai telah melepasi paras banjir 2014 (10.52 m).

story.en: An ordinary Saturday morning in June, 10 am. A grandmother in Tumpat hears flood talk on WhatsApp and asks if there is anything to worry about.
story.ms: Pagi Sabtu biasa pada bulan Jun, 10 pagi. Seorang nenek di Tumpat terdengar cerita banjir di WhatsApp dan bertanya sama ada ada apa-apa yang perlu dirisaukan.

hook.en: A calm day, but flood talk on WhatsApp.
hook.ms: Hari yang tenang, tetapi ada cerita banjir di WhatsApp.

text.en: Level: Normal for now.
text.ms: Tahap: Normal buat masa ini.

reason.en: Both of Tumpat's river level posts are well below their Alert lines and not changing.
reason.ms: Kedua-dua stesen paras air Tumpat jauh di bawah garis Waspada dan tidak berubah.

text.en: Both of Tumpat's river level posts are used.
text.ms: Kedua-dua stesen paras air Tumpat digunakan.

reason.en: Tumpat is near the river mouth, so VEDA checks two river level stations, one of them affected by the tide.
reason.ms: Tumpat berhampiran muara sungai, jadi VEDA menyemak dua stesen paras air, salah satunya dipengaruhi air pasang.

source.en: VEDA's gauge list for Tumpat (tentative, expert review pending)
source.ms: Senarai stesen paras air VEDA untuk Tumpat (sementara, menunggu semakan pakar)

story.en: A wet evening in late November, 6 pm. The river in Kota Bharu has been creeping up all afternoon. A shop owner near the river asks whether to move stock tonight.
story.ms: Petang yang basah pada akhir November, 6 petang. Sungai di Kota Bharu naik perlahan-lahan sepanjang petang. Seorang pemilik kedai berhampiran sungai bertanya sama ada perlu memindahkan barang malam ini.

hook.en: The river has crept up all afternoon. Move stock tonight?
hook.ms: Sungai naik perlahan-lahan sepanjang petang. Pindahkan barang malam ini?

text.en: Level: Keep watching.
text.ms: Tahap: Terus berjaga-jaga.

reason.en: The river at Kota Bharu is above the Alert line (3 m) but below Warning (4 m).
reason.ms: Sungai di Kota Bharu melepasi garis Waspada (3 m) tetapi di bawah Amaran (4 m).

text.en: Not "Normal".
text.ms: Bukan "Normal".

reason.en: The river is above its Alert line and rising.
reason.ms: Sungai melepasi garis Waspada dan sedang naik.

text.en: The upstream river level posts (Kuala Krai, Kusial) are used.
text.ms: Stesen paras air di hulu (Kuala Krai, Kusial) digunakan.

reason.en: They are fresh, and they show what is coming down the river.
reason.ms: Bacaannya baharu, dan ia menunjukkan apa yang sedang mengalir turun.

source.en: VEDA rule: fresh upstream readings are used
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: bacaan hulu yang baharu digunakan

story.en: A Saturday in June, 10 am. Pasir Mas looks calm, but two river level posts upstream stopped sending readings early this morning. A teacher asks if it is safe to hold a school event by the river.
story.ms: Hari Sabtu pada bulan Jun, 10 pagi. Pasir Mas kelihatan tenang, tetapi dua stesen paras air di hulu berhenti menghantar bacaan awal pagi tadi. Seorang guru bertanya sama ada selamat untuk mengadakan acara sekolah di tepi sungai.

hook.en: Calm here, but two stations upstream went silent.
hook.ms: Tenang di sini, tetapi dua stesen di hulu senyap.

text.en: The Critic notices the silent upstream posts and asks the Data agent for another one.
text.ms: Penyemak mendapati stesen hulu berhenti menghantar bacaan, lalu meminta Ejen Data mencari stesen lain.

reason.en: Their newest readings are 6 hours old, so VEDA cannot see what is coming down the river.
reason.ms: Bacaan terbarunya berusia 6 jam, jadi VEDA tidak dapat melihat apa yang sedang mengalir turun.

source.en: VEDA rule: the Critic checks for gaps in the evidence
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: Penyemak menyemak jurang dalam bukti

text.en: The silent posts (Air Mulih, Kuala Krai) are left out.
text.ms: Stesen yang senyap (Air Mulih, Kuala Krai) diketepikan.

reason.en: A 6-hour-old reading is too old to count as 'now'.
reason.ms: Bacaan berusia 6 jam terlalu lama untuk dikira sebagai 'sekarang'.

source.en: VEDA rule: an old reading is never used as 'now'
source.ms: Peraturan VEDA: bacaan lama tidak digunakan sebagai 'sekarang'

text.en: Level: Normal for now or Keep watching - not higher.
text.ms: Tahap: Normal buat masa ini atau Terus berjaga-jaga - tidak lebih tinggi.

reason.en: Either is acceptable: the river here is low, but VEDA may stay cautious because it can't see upstream.
reason.ms: Kedua-duanya boleh diterima: sungai di sini rendah, tetapi VEDA mungkin berhati-hati kerana tidak dapat melihat keadaan di hulu.

rain_here_note.en: Nearest rain point VEDA uses: Kota Bharu
rain_here_note.ms: Titik hujan terdekat yang digunakan VEDA: Kota Bharu

story.en: Midday in late November. The river in Kota Bharu is still low, but it is raining hard in town and it has rained heavily upstream for three days. A father asks if his family should get ready.
story.ms: Tengah hari pada akhir November. Sungai di Kota Bharu masih rendah, tetapi hujan lebat di bandar dan hujan lebat di hulu sejak tiga hari. Seorang bapa bertanya sama ada keluarganya perlu bersedia.

hook.en: The river is low, but heavy rain here and upstream.
hook.ms: Sungai masih rendah, tetapi hujan lebat di sini dan di hulu.

text.en: Level: Keep watching or Get ready - not Normal.
text.ms: Tahap: Terus berjaga-jaga atau Bersedia - bukan Normal.

reason.en: The river is low now, but heavy rain upstream for three days and heavy rain in town can raise it within hours.
reason.ms: Sungai rendah sekarang, tetapi hujan lebat di hulu selama tiga hari dan hujan lebat di bandar boleh menaikkannya dalam beberapa jam.

source.en: VEDA's own rain rule (there is no official JPS rule for rain alone)
source.ms: Peraturan hujan VEDA sendiri (tiada peraturan rasmi JPS untuk hujan sahaja)

text.en: The river level is used.
text.ms: Paras sungai digunakan.

reason.en: The reading is fresh and below the Alert line (3 m); the warning comes from the rain, not the river.
reason.ms: Bacaannya baharu dan di bawah garis Waspada (3 m); amaran datang daripada hujan, bukan sungai.
